---
title: "Quelccaya"
lang: en
description: "MeteoAndes field and remote-sensing evidence for Quelccaya."
---

Quelccaya connects glacier meteorology, atmospheric eBC and stratigraphic snow/ice sampling. The 2026 inventory contains 48 samples. A 222 ng m⁻³ AL30 value is an instantaneous context measurement, not a climatology or deposition estimate.
